decisions.rationale: No Mega on my side. Lead Farigiraf + Mudsdale: Farigiraf sets Trick Room (Armor Tail blocks priority), Mudsdale OHKOs Charizard with Stone Edge (4x). Back Gholdengo (Good as Gold blocks Venusaur status) + Azumarill (Fairy/Water coverage, Aqua Jet priority). Mudsdale survives Heat Wave under sun well.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Charizard-Mega-Y (Drought), Venusaur (Chlorophyll, WideLens Sleep Powder), Garchomp (Life Orb Jolly), Primarina (WiseGlasses Modest), Raichu (Lightning Rod, Fake Out, Sitrus), Goodra-Hisui (Shell Armor). My plan: Trick Room reverses speed advantage; Armor Tail neuters priority; Mudsdale Stone Edge OHKOs Charizard; Gholdengo status-immune handles Venusaur. Game 1 lead Farigiraf+Mudsdale, back Gholdengo+Azumarill.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Charizard Y. Charizard-Venusaur immediately creates sun, threatens Gholdengo with Heat Wave, and uses fast Chlorophyll Sleep Powder to deny Farigiraf’s Trick Room. Garchomp is the fast anti-Gholdengo endgame if Trick Room is denied; Goodra-Hisui gives a bulky answer into their special attackers and Trevenant under Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s six is a dedicated slow Trick Room shell: Farigiraf and Trevenant both carry Trick Room, with Quiet/Brave Gholdengo, Rotom-Wash, Azumarill, Mudsdale, and Trevenant. Preserve the Mega Charizard Y + Venusaur sun mode as primary: pressure Gholdengo with Heat Wave and deny Trick Room through Sleep Powder on Farigiraf when possible. Good as Gold prevents Venusaur status into Gholdengo; Armor Tail blocks priority while Farigiraf is active.

decisions.rationale: Protect Farigiraf blocks Sleep Powder, ensuring Trick Room is live next turn. Stone Edge is guaranteed OHKO on Charizard (4x). Mudsdale survives Solar Beam/Heat Wave due to Occa Berry and full HP. If Stone Edge misses, Farigiraf sets Trick Room turn 2.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead: Farigiraf+Mudsdale vs Charizard+Venusaur. Opponent has no priority to break Armor Tail. Key: set Trick Room, KO Charizard with Stone Edge. Back: Gholdengo (status immune, handles Venusaur) + Azumarill (Huge Power, Aqua Jet priority). Avoid letting Venusaur set Sun+Chlorophyll sweep. Watch for Garchomp Life Orb EQ, Primarina Moonblast, Raichu Lightning Rod redirecting Electric moves.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo is immune to Sleep Powder via Good as Gold and resists Charizard's Fire moves. Power Gem threatens Charizard (80-169% possible OHKO). Azumarill risks OHKO from Venusaur Energy Ball (37-128%). Farigiraf passes this turn as only option available.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Charizard+Venusaur under Sun, uses Sleep Powder to block Trick Room. Charizard Mega turn 1, used Solar Beam. Venusaur Wide Lens (82% effective Sleep Powder). Backline: Garchomp Life Orb Jolly (EQ, Rock Slide), Primarina Wise Glasses Modest (Moonblast, Ice Beam, Haze), Raichu Sitrus Berry Timid (Fake Out, Nuzzle, Lightning Rod), Goodra-Hisui Leftovers Modest (Flamethrower, Dragon Pulse, Body Press). My key: Gholdengo handles Venusaur/status immune, Power Gem threatens Charizard. Azumarill Aqua Jet priority for late game. Avoid giving Venusaur free turns to sleep key targets.

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolving creates sun so Solar Beam immediately removes Mudsdale before its Stone Edge can act. Venusaur then gains Chlorophyll speed and Sleep Powder is the best available Trick Room denial; Wide Lens raises its reliability. This preserves the sun endgame while preventing the most dangerous immediate damage.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s six is a dedicated slow Trick Room shell: Farigiraf and Trevenant carry Trick Room, with Quiet/Brave Gholdengo, Rotom-Wash, Azumarill, Mudsdale, and Trevenant. Preserve Mega Charizard Y + Venusaur sun as primary mode; use Sleep Powder to deny Trick Room when possible. Good as Gold prevents Venusaur status into Gholdengo; Armor Tail blocks priority while Farigiraf is active.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: Heat Wave OHKOs Gholdengo (173-292%), so Protect is mandatory. Farigiraf attempts Trick Room; if Sleep Powder misses (17.5%), TR goes up and we dominate. If hit, Gholdengo survives unscathed to KO Charizard next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur; backline Garchomp Life Orb Jolly, Primarina Wise Glasses Modest, Raichu Sitrus Timid (Fake Out/Nuzzle/LightningRod), Goodra-H Leftovers Modest. Venusaur Wide Lens (82% Sleep Powder). Key: Gholdengo immune to Sleep Powder (Good as Gold) and Poison. Need to remove Charizard to reduce Sun pressure. Azumarill Aqua Jet priority for late game. Mudsdale fainted.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur acts first and Sleep Powder is the best available denial of Trick Room; Farigiraf's repeat Protect is unreliable. Charizard then outspeeds Gholdengo and sun-boosted spread Heat Wave guarantees its KO if it connects, preventing Power Gem. This retains sun pressure and leaves the opponent without their immediate offensive threat.
decisions.notebook: Opponent is committed to a slow Trick Room shell with Farigiraf and Trevenant as setters. Prioritize Sleep Powder into available Trick Room setters; Good as Gold blocks status aimed at Gholdengo. Mega Charizard Y plus Chlorophyll Venusaur is the primary mode; preserve sun tempo. Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks priority while active.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: CharY outspeeds and OHKOs Gholdengo with Heat Wave in Sun, so attacking first is impossible. Protect (33% success) is the only way Gholdengo survives to KO CharY next turn. Switching Farigiraf preserves it and brings Azumarill (resists Heat Wave 23-43%) to help. This maximizes the chance of keeping both Pokémon for the upcoming 2v2+backline.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur; backline Garchomp LO Jolly, Primarina Wise Glasses Modest, Raichu Sitrus Timid (FakeOut/Nuzzle/LightningRod), Goodra-H Leftovers Modest. Venusaur Wide Lens (82% Sleep Powder). Key: Gholdengo immune to Sleep Powder (Good as Gold) and Poison. Azumarill Aqua Jet priority for late game. Heat Wave in Sun is the central threat to Gholdengo. Need to remove CharY to reduce Sun pressure. Mudsdale fainted, so only Azumarill in reserve.

decisions.rationale: Only Farigiraf remains. Switch to slot 1, pass slot 2. Opponent double-targets for KO; need a miss or early wake-up to survive and set Trick Room. Both switches functionally identical.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur; backline Garchomp LO Jolly, Primarina Wise Glasses Modest, Raichu Sitrus Timid (FakeOut/Nuzzle/LightningRod), Goodra-H Leftovers Modest. Venusaur Wide Lens 82% Sleep Powder. CharY Solar Beam in sun no charge. My Farigiraf only remaining mon; if it wakes and sets Trick Room, can outslow both. Key: Gholdengo immune to Sleep Powder (Good as Gold). Heat Wave is central threat to Gholdengo. Need to remove CharY to reduce Sun pressure.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur is guaranteed to move first and Sludge Bomb removes Farigiraf from its shown HP before it can wake and set Trick Room. Charizard then moves before Gholdengo and sun-boosted Heat Wave threatens its Fire weakness; this also covers a Farigiraf wake better than relying on sleep.

Only Farigiraf remains vs 4 foes. If it wakes, Trick Room (priority -7) goes last after Venusaur+CharY attacks. Sitrus Berry may absorb the weaker hit. Once TR is up, Farigiraf's 72 Speed underspeeds everything, enabling Psychic KOs on Venusaur and CharY. Without TR, the speed deficit is hopeless. Protect delays the inevitable; Psychic risks being KO'd before acting.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur with sun; backline Garchomp LO Jolly, Primarina Wise Glasses Modest, Raichu Sitrus Timid (FakeOut/Nuzzle/LightningRod), Goodra-H Leftovers Modest Shell Armor. Venusaur runs Wide Lens (82% Sleep Powder). CharY Solar Beam is instant in sun. Key: Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder—useful if it returns. Farigiraf's Sitrus Berry can survive one strong hit. Trick Room makes Farigiraf faster than all backline mons except possibly Raichu? Actually Raichu base 110 + Timid = 143-178, Farigiraf 72 is slower, so under TR Farigiraf moves first. Watch for Raichu Lightning Rod redirecting Psychic. Plan for game 2: consider bringing Mudsdale to absorb sun-boosted hits and set up Stamina, or Azumarill Aqua Jet to bypass sun/speed issues.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf is the final opposing Pokémon. Double-target with two 100% accurate attacks to cover its remaining HP and avoid Heat Wave or Air Slash accuracy. If it remains asleep, this ends the game; only a wake-and-Protect delays the KO.

Game is at a material deficit (12% Farigiraf vs 2 full-HP mons + 2 backline). Trick Room lets Farigiraf move first. Psychic on Venusaur is super-effective (2x) and can deal 47-85% damage, the only meaningful action. Protect or Gleam accomplish nothing. Accept the loss while scouting Venusaur's bulk.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lost from massive advantage. Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur every time in sun. Key note: Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder — useful for game 2/3. Venusaur's Speed under sun + Chlorophyll is 200-264, but Trick Room reverses that to make slower mons like Farigiraf (72) or Mudsdale (49) move first. Raichu (143-178 Timid) is faster than Farigiraf out of TR but slower under TR — plan to control speed either way. Primarina Wise Glasses Modest, Garchomp LO Jolly, Goodra-H Leftovers Modest Shell Armor. For game 2: consider Mudsdale to absorb sun hits and boost Stamina, or Azumarill Aqua Jet to bypass speed. Evident that CharY Solar Beam is instant in sun.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf is the final opposing Pokémon. Venusaur Protect denies its immediate super-effective Psychic, while Solar Beam is the accurate, strongest listed direct hit and previously brought Farigiraf to low HP. This wins immediately unless Farigiraf Protects; Heat Wave adds unnecessary accuracy risk.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s brought mode was Farigiraf/Mudsdale/Gholdengo/Azumarill; Rotom-Wash and Trevenant were not brought. Farigiraf used Trick Room and has Armor Tail plus Sitrus Berry. Continue prioritizing fast pressure and Sleep Powder into Trick Room setters when they are not protected or status-immune.

reflections.summary: Lost because the opponent's sun duo (CharY+Venusaur) overwhelmed our team before Trick Room was set. Mudsdale fell to Solar Beam turn 1, Farigiraf was slept turn 2, and the subsequent double target eliminated Azumarill and Gholdengo turn 3. Trick Room only came up turn 4, too late to recover.
reflections.adjustment: Game 2: Lead with Gholdengo and Farigiraf. Turn 1: Farigiraf Protects, Gholdengo uses Power Gem on CharY (4x effective). This blocks Sleep Powder and Solar Beam, preserving Farigiraf. Turn 2: Farigiraf sets Trick Room while Gholdengo attacks or Protects. Under TR, bring in Mudsdale or Azumarill to clean up. Keep Gholdengo alive as it resists both CharY and Venusaur.
reflections.notebook: Opponent leads CharY+Venusaur in sun every time. CharY uses Solar Beam and Heat Wave freely; Venusaur uses Sleep Powder liberally. Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder and resists CharY's moves. Venusaur Protect used turn 5. Under Trick Room, slower mons like Mudsdale (49) and Azumarill (63) move first. Plan: lead Gholdengo+Farigiraf, protect Farigiraf turn 1, set TR turn 2, then use Mudsdale's Stone Edge or Azumarill's Aqua Jet under TR.

reflections.summary: Won because the Mega Charizard Y/Venusaur sun lead matched their Trick Room mode well: Mudsdale was removed before Trick Room, then Farigiraf was put to sleep and Trick Room was delayed until their remaining attackers were already gone. The chosen four and Mega were well suited to this opponent.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the Charizard Y/Venusaur lead and same four, but expect Farigiraf to Protect on turn 1; after that reveal, immediately prioritize sleep or direct pressure on Farigiraf before it can establish Trick Room.
reflections.notebook: Opponent selected a Farigiraf-centered Trick Room mode in game 1. Farigiraf showed turn-1 Protect, then attempted Trick Room after waking; it has Armor Tail and Sitrus Berry. Their Gholdengo was Life Orb and used Protect. Continue using Mega Charizard Y/Venusaur fast sun pressure, with Sleep Powder pressure on Farigiraf to delay Trick Room.
